title: DARK HUNTER KURO
description:
STORYTachio, an ordinary office worker, is suddenly transported one day to another world overrun by dark monsters known as Yamimon.

In this unfamiliar land, he is attacked by Yamimon—but is saved by a beautiful dark hunter named Kuro (Red Wolf), whose striking red hair and voluptuous figure leave a strong impression.

However, the moment Tachio makes contact with her, he fuses with her special battle suit known as Gear.

From that point on, Tachio fights alongside her—not as a warrior, but as her battle suit— while the two search for a way to return to his original world.

GAMEA stylish action game featuring exhilarating combat and smooth HD pixel animations, with a bold and voluptuous visual style!

Unleash devastating Dark Techniques, combine them with Snatch, a scarf-based move that pulls enemies in, and chain together flexible, high-impact combos!

All erotic scenes are voice-recorded. Enjoy your wonderful time with an immersive experience!

 

FEATURES• Action Game

• Extremely intense H-scenes

• Fully animated erotic scenes

• Thousands of lines of voice recorded
description_short: Wear the ever-changing battle suit “Gear” and scatter the grotesque enemies! Simple controls deliver exhilarating stylish action. Freely combine a rich arsenal of special moves and unleash relentless combos. In a devastated near-future setting—gorgeous, powerful, and sexy!
